Yes Nick, you could give that a try.  It does come with challenges however, as I said trails are not particularly representative samplers of the environment.  Hence, environmental covariates that you measure near the trails (canopy cover, elevation, etc.) are not an unbiased sample of the study area to which you wish to make inference.  Trails usually traverse the least steep slopes, etc.


Recognise the limitations of the inferences you can draw.
